series.label: COVID-19 — wastewater viral activity level, Minnesota (median of 27 reporting sites, derived)
series.note: Derived by MN Pulse from CDC NWSS site data: each week's median Wastewater Viral Activity Level across the Minnesota sites reporting COVID-19 that week, leaving out sites still in their baseline start-up period (before CDC's WVAL inclusion date). This is similar to CDC's described approach for state levels (median of site WVALs), but CDC's own state value may differ. Weeks with fewer than 3 reporting sites are omitted; 35 sites reported in the first week shown (2022-05-28) and 27 in the latest, so the mix of sites behind the median changes over time. A WVAL of exactly 1 is common (most likely at or below a site's baseline), so the median is 1 whenever most sites report 1 (16 of 27 in the latest week).

attrs.method: median of site WVALs (sites past WVAL start-up)
